## GET /v1/redfin/property - 1-2 credits (request-shaped)

Returns one Redfin home in full by its link. Each home is a Place: `place.id` is the Redfin property id, `place.name` the street line, `place.address` the full address, with coordinates, photos and the listing link; `place.ext.listing` carries the price, status, beds, baths, square feet, lot size, year built and monthly HOA fee. The record adds the description, the price history (`place.ext.listing.price_history`: each event's date, price where shown, what happened, for example Listed or Sold (Public Records), and its source, back decades through public records) and the yearly tax history (`tax_history`: tax and, where it is published, the assessed value). Send `include=details` and the home is looked up once more, in the same call, for the listing agent and brokerage with their phones (`place.ext.listing.agent`), the scheduled open houses (`open_houses`), how many times the listing was viewed and saved on Redfin (`views_count`, `saves_count`), the schools assigned to the address with their rating out of 10, grades, distance and size (`schools`), the points of interest nearby with their distance (`nearby_places`), and every property fact Redfin lists, from heating and parking to the annual tax, as labelled rows (`property_facts`), for 1 credit more, kept only when the details land. It adds about 2 to 6 seconds (5.4 measured 21/11/2026), and the response carries a `hydration` block; when the lookup cannot run, `data._warnings` says `details_unavailable` and the credit is refunded. Without it the call is unchanged.

**Use when** Use it with a Redfin home link when you need one home's sale and tax history.
**Cost** price moves with `include` · cache 900 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Pricing** 1 credit for the home. include=details holds 1 credit more and keeps it only when the details land; a lookup that fills nothing is refunded.
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - A Redfin home link ending in /home/<id>, for example https://www.redfin.com/TX/Austin/8023-Acton-Dr-78736/home/31709039. · e.g. `https://www.redfin.com/TX/Austin/8023-Acton-Dr-78736/home/31709039`
- `include` (optional, enum: details) - Set to `details` to add the listing agent, open houses, views and saves, assigned schools, nearby places and every listed property fact under `place.ext.listing`, for 1 credit more, kept only when they land. Without it the call is unchanged.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude}; `place.ext` {listing}; `place.ext.listing` {agent, nearby_places, open_houses, property_facts, saves_count, schools, views_count}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.rating.max`, `place.rating.value`, `place.reviews_count`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.hydration`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/redfin/property" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.redfin.com/TX/Austin/8023-Acton-Dr-78736/home/31709039" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/redfin/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Redfin homes for sale or recently sold in one call: up to limit homes (100 by default, at most 350) for a Redfin search link (url, for example a city, ZIP code or neighborhood page), a Redfin region (region_id with region_type), a map box (map_bounds), or a place name (location). Each home is a Place: `place.id` is the Redfin property id, `place.name` the street line, `place.address` the full address, with coordinates, photos and the listing link; `place.ext.listing` carries the price, status, beds, baths, square feet, lot size, year built and monthly HOA fee. Up to 200 homes, every home carries its photos and description; a search by region_id or map_bounds, and some searches above 200 homes, come without them. When more than 200 homes are asked for, the answer can hold 200 with a `limit_capped` warning on `data._warnings` saying so; ask again or narrow the search. When a search reaches its limit, narrow the area or the filters to see more. Filter by property type, price, beds, baths, square feet and, for sold homes, how recently they sold.

**Use when** you want to pull a whole area's listings or recent sales at once; narrow the area when a search reaches its limit.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** single page - One call returns up to `limit` homes (100 by default, at most 350); narrow the area or the filters for more. Above 200 homes a call can be answered with 200 and a `limit_capped` warning.

**Query params**

- `url` (optional, string) - A Redfin search link, for example https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin. · e.g. `https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin`
- `location` (optional, string) - A place name, for example Austin, TX.
- `region_id` (optional, integer, min 1) - Redfin region id; needs region_type.
- `region_type` (optional, enum: 1 | 2 | 5 | 6 | 11) - Region kind: 1 neighborhood, 2 ZIP code, 5 county, 6 city, 11 state.
- `map_bounds` (optional, string) - A map box: north,east,south,west in decimal degrees.
- `status` (optional, enum: for_sale | sold) - for_sale (default) or sold.
- `sold_within_days` (optional, integer, 1-1825) - Sold in the last N days; with status=sold. Defaults to 180.
- `property_type` (optional, enum: house | condo | townhouse | multi_family | land | other | manufactured | co_op) - One home type: house, condo, townhouse, multi_family, land, other, manufactured or co_op.
- `sort` (optional, enum: recommended | newest | price_asc | price_desc | sqft) - recommended (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc or sqft. The order is Redfin's own and is not strict: on sold homes a few rows can sit out of price order.
- `price_min` (optional, integer, min 0) - Lowest price in US dollars.
- `price_max` (optional, integer, min 0) - Highest price in US dollars.
- `beds_min` (optional, integer, min 0) - Fewest bedrooms.
- `beds_max` (optional, integer, min 0) - Most bedrooms.
- `baths_min` (optional, string) - Fewest bathrooms.
- `sqft_min` (optional, integer, min 0) - Smallest interior area in square feet.
- `sqft_max` (optional, integer, min 0) - Largest interior area in square feet.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-350) - Homes returned, 1 to 350. Defaults to 100. · e.g. `50`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `url`, `location`, `region_id`, `map_bounds`.
- `region_type` is a no-op without `region_id` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |

+2 more (types in the full schema): `place` {longitude}; `place.ext` {listing}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.rating.max`, `place.rating.value`, `place.reviews_count`, `place.verified`. Empty on every row the field-health check sampled (22/11/2026), so not returned today: `place.description`, `place.image_urls`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/redfin/search" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
